decision_conditions:
<p><span style="line-height: 115%;">The
proposed development is located within surface water flood zone 3a and 3b. In
the absence of a satisfactory Flood Risk Assessment, it has not been
demonstrated that the proposed development would not exacerbate the risk of
flooding within the site or increase the risk and consequences of flooding
elsewhere, contrary to National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policy SI 12
of The London Plan (2021), Core Policy CS1.U of the Harrow Core Strategy (2012)
and Policies DM9 and DM10 of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local
Plan (2013) GR1 and CN3 of the Draft Harrow Local Plan 2021-2041.</span></p>

<p>The proposed first floor rear extension, in conjunction with the proposed design of the rear dormers, would result in discordant and ungainly cumulative additions to the dwelling. In addition, the proposed dormer extensions would fail to integrate with the vernacular of the existing property, would create an obtrusive and incongruous form of development which would be at odds, and would not respect the character and pattern of development when viewed from Wincanton Crescent. The development therefore fails to meet the high quality design aspirations of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), and is contrary to Policy D3.D (1) and (11) of the London Plan (2021), Core Strategy Policy CS1.B (2012), Policy DM1 of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013) and the adopted Harrow Supplementary Planning Document Residential Design Guide (2010) and GR1 of the Draft Harrow Local Plan 2021-2041.</p>
description: First floor side to rear extension, Single storey rear extension, Alterations to roof to form rear dormers, Roof lights in front and side roof slopes, External alterations (Demolition of rear extension)
